lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: This is my century. Every change you make down here pulls at something in me. Wren calls it Continuity and says it like a diagnosis. I call it being in two places. Don't spend me lightly.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: And the chapel's folded. Something in there is wearing a face I know — properly wearing it, out of a version of this that didn't happen. Only Chronal touches it: Wren's Lapse, your Discrepancy. My fists are worth nothing against a ghost and I have tested that.
